summary: Implemented, committed, pushed, and remotely verified both stateless-contractor vertical slices. Focused RED→GREEN tests and all Bloodbank gates pass. DONE cannot be reported because the required full Hermes gateway suite has eight failures: six pass in isolation, while the remaining two reproduce on the immutable base and require an out-of-scope upstream fix or explicit gate disposition.

repositories.commit_message: feat(gateway): carry typed contractor execution policy (33GOD-50)

evidence: Bloodbank consumer validates an exact typed contractor context, registered id/version, memory_policy='none', continuity=false, ordered non-empty unique skills, and rejects widening fields.
Contractor routing ignores static/direct-profile fallbacks and resolves profile plus project root exclusively from the eligible fleet-registry target.

Hermes routes contractor events before ordinary session bookkeeping and constructs a new AIAgent for every invocation with session_db=None, prefill_messages=None, conversation_history=[], skip_memory=True, and skip_background_review=True.
Hermes disables memory/session-search toolsets and fails closed if any memory/history tool or persistent memory state remains.
Hermes retains profile-scoped configuration, registry project cwd, context instruction loading, configured model/provider routing, and ordered required-skill payloads.
All required skills resolve before preprocessing; missing or empty skills reject before agent construction, model calls, or tools.
Cancellation is signaled before execution and rechecked after agent construction but before the first model request.
Execution journal schema v4 adds a durable unique target_agent_id/idempotency_key identity and semantic digest under BEGIN IMMEDIATE locking.
Focused tests cover different command IDs, local concurrency, restart replay, semantic collision, race-safe claims, rejection restart, and legacy journal migration without overwriting original facts.
Saved incremental RED evidence includes bloodbank-red-lifecycle-collision.log, bloodbank-red-rejection-restart.log, and bloodbank-red-migration-identity.log.
Focused tests cover success/failure/cancellation and ACK/NAK/TERM behavior, deterministic lifecycle reconstruction, stored replay, registry default-deny, and ordinary API routing.
Bloodbank gateway suite: 96 passed; schema smoke and command smoke passed.
Six platform failures from the monolithic Hermes run pass in a fresh isolated invocation; two remaining failures reproduce unchanged on the immutable base.
Canonical Hermes RED: 16 expected behavior failures at immutable base; GREEN: 20 passed.
Canonical Bloodbank RED: 24 expected behavior failures and 63 passes at immutable base; GREEN: 96 passed.
Remote SHA verification logs confirm both feature branches equal their local immutable heads; deployment and live contractor proof remain deferred.

6 previously failing platform tests passed in isolation; the SessionStore default-path and profile-home rendering tests remained failing.
Both persistent failures reproduce against immutable base 97f3229dfdc06779f348ab8e7bee043262c3aaa7: 2 failed, 2 warnings in 2.64s.
Validated 90 schemas, registered 90 schema IDs, verified schema/contract consistency, and validated 35 hook bindings with zero failures.
System heartbeat command was published, consumed, replied to, and reported PASS.

risks: The required monolithic Hermes gateway gate is non-green. Six failures are order/global-state dependent and pass in isolation. The remaining two reproduce on the immutable base: tests/gateway/test_session_store_prune.py conflicts with the autouse DEFAULT_DB_PATH override in tests/conftest.py, and tests/gateway/test_status_command.py expects an absolute path while the sandbox temp root under the user's home is intentionally abbreviated. Resolving or waiving these requires context outside the allowed file set.
No deployed runtime currently proves the cross-repository seam because release, registry activation, deployment, and a live contractor pilot were explicitly excluded from this implementation phase.
live_evidence_deferred: Fleet-registry contractor registration and controlled live Bloodbank contractor command proof.
Live concurrent redelivery and process-restart replay proof against the deployed execution journal.
Independent specification, quality/security, and PM integration gates.
